description: This PHP source file defines the BuzzAnniversaryDao class, which extends BaseDao and provides methods to retrieve and count upcoming employee anniversaries based on search filter parameters. It constructs database queries with date calculations and filtering conditions.

classes.name: BuzzAnniversaryDao
classes.description: Data Access Object for employee anniversary data, providing methods to fetch upcoming anniversaries list and count.

methods.name: getUpcomingAnniversariesList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of upcoming anniversaries based on provided search filters.

methods.name: getUpcomingAnniversariesPaginator
methods.description: Internal method that constructs and returns a paginator for upcoming anniversaries based on search filters.

methods.name: getUpcomingAnniversariesCount
methods.description: Returns the count of upcoming anniversaries based on search filters.
